{{Short description|none}}

[[File:Pesne_Geometrician.jpg|thumb|Geometric drawing made with ruler and compass]]
'''Geometric drawing''' consists of a set of processes for constructing geometric shapes and solving problems with the use of a [[ruler]] without graduation and the [[compass (drawing tool)]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lôr |first=Elen Andrea Janzen |title=Postulados do Desenho Geométrico |url=http://www.degraf.ufpr.br/docentes/Elen/Desenho%20Geometrico%20Arquitetura.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150206135137/http://www.degraf.ufpr.br/docentes/Elen/Desenho%20Geometrico%20Arquitetura.pdf |archive-date=6 February 2015 |access-date=6 July 2013 |website=Universidade Federal do Paraná |language=Portuguese}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Putnoki |first=José Carlos |title=Que se devolvam a Euclides a régua e compasso |journal=Revista do Professor de Matemática |publisher=Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática São Paulo: Associação Palas Athena do Brasil |volume=2 |issue=13 |pages=13–17}}</ref> Modernly, such studies can be done with the aid of [[Cabri Geometry|software]], which simulates the strokes performed by these instruments.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Elenice de Souza Lodron Zuin, Da Régua e do Compasso: As Construções Geométricas Como Um Saber Escolar No Brasil |url=http://www.bibliotecadigital.ufmg.br/dspace/bitstream/handle/1843/FAEC-85DGQB/zuin_elenice_disserta_nopw.pdf?sequence=1 |language=Portuguese |access-date=2023-02-22 |archive-date=2014-05-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140519203412/http://www.bibliotecadigital.ufmg.br/dspace/bitstream/handle/1843/FAEC-85DGQB/zuin_elenice_disserta_nopw.pdf?sequence=1 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

For ancient mathematicians, [[geometry]] could not do without the methods of geometric constructions, necessary for understanding, theoretical enrichment, and problem-solving.

The accuracy and precision required of geometric drawing make it an important ally in the application of geometric concepts in significant areas of human knowledge, such as [[architecture]], [[engineering]], [[industrial design]], among others.
[[File:Régua_e_compasso.jpg|thumb|Ruler and compass]]
The process of geometric drawing is based on constructions with a ruler and compass, which in turn are based on the first three postulates of [[Euclid's Elements|Euclid's ''Elements'']].

The historical importance of rulers and compasses as instruments in solving geometric problems leads many authors to limit Geometric Drawing to the representation and solution of geometric figures in the plane.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Giongo |first=Afonso Rocha |title=Curso de Desenho Geométrico |publisher=Nobel |year=1954 |location=São Paulo |pages=7 |language=pt}}</ref>

With the development of computer-aided design ([[Computer-aided design|CAD]]) programs, geometric drawing has become more important in teaching-learning processes (development of spatial faculties) than the more imprecise tracing offered by rulers and compasses, when taking into account the precision of computer systems.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Mandarino |first=Denis |title=Desenho Geométrico, construções com régua e compasso |publisher=Plêiade |year=2007 |location=São Paulo |pages=7 |language=pt}}</ref>
